senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Acco, Accho (Ptolemais), a town and harbor on the Phœnician shores.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:6">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>כלום מביאין … דגים לע׳</he> do people carry … fish to Acco? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:8">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>דג העולה מע׳</he> fish from A.
Tosef. Shebi. V, 2; a. fr.—כְּפַר ע׳ K’far Acco, v. אִכּוּם.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:12">Tosef. Kil. I, 12</cite>; Mekh. Yithro, Amal., s. 2 <he>יהודה איש כ׳ ע׳</he>.
